messages:
alex: kicking off an account + VPC orientation for the new ap-east-light region. goal: get a GPU-capable project, VPC layout, and handoff checklist so infra can provision clusters next week. short list below.

tara: sounds good — do we already have a billing account or is this a new tenant?

alex: new tenant; billing account attached is BA-REDWOOD-AP. cloud acct id 987654321000. tagging standard: env=prod, cost-center=ml-platform, owner=infra.

sanjay: note: the provider has limited A100 stock in that zone. we should request quota early and pick fallback sku (V100 or A10G) for canary. open ticket with provider today.

ira: +1. also want to confirm network CIDR plan. do we want 10.40.0.0/16 split into 4 /18s (control, compute, shared services, prod apps)?

alex: yes — proposed:
- control: 10.40.0.0/18
- compute-gpu: 10.40.64.0/18
- shared-services (logging/metrics): 10.40.128.0/18
- customer-facing apps: 10.40.192.0/18

tara: that's tighter than org default but ok for initial region. we must add route table names and NAT pools in the runbook.

infra-bot: quota-check: GPU quota for project 987654321000 = 0/quotas (limit 0). Action: submit quota request form.

alex: submitting quota request now. proto: attach expected capacity (8 x A100) + fallback A10G (12) and request expedited review. I'll paste the ticket.

alex: ticket link: https://support.provider.example/cases/RED-4123

sanjay: when you open the ticket include expected sustained vCPU, ephemeral SSD needs (2 TB NVMe per node), and burst network egress estimate. provider asked for egress because of porting large model checkpoints.

ira: networking checklist items I want in the orientation doc:
1) VPC name conventions and tags
2) subnet CIDRs + AZ mapping
3) dedicated NAT gateway per AZ (for deterministic egress billing)
4) route tables and explicit firewall rules for cluster control plane (port 22, 2379, 443, 10250 restricted to ops subnets)
5) shared services peering (logging/metrics project)
6) DNS delegation for internal FQDNs
7) flow logs enabled

tara: add: KMS key ARN for secrets encryption (customer-managed), and audit log sink to central logging project. also IAM roles we need: compute.admin (for provisioning), storage.admin (for checkpointing buckets), and a least-priv infra-svc-role for autoscaler.

alex: draft terraform module reference: git@repo:redwood/infra-modules//vpc?ref=service-onboard-ap-east. We'll parameterize `gpu_subnets`, `nat_count`, `shared_services_peering_project`.

ira: validation steps post-apply:
- can ping gateway from bastion
- node boot tests: spin one gpu test instance, attach NVMe, mount, run fio for 10m
- kubelet register with control-plane with certs
- test upload/download to checkpoint bucket (s3-compatible)
- verify flow logs show accepted traffic from control plane

alex: quick commands for quota and validation I'll paste: 
- AWS example quota check (aws): `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A`
- GCP example: `gcloud compute regions describe ap-east1 --project=987654321000`
- NIC/SG check: `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod`

sanjay: cost note: picking A100s will add ~+60% on OPEX compared to A10G. propose starting with mixed instance policy in the ASG to allow fallback. include cost-approval signature in handoff doc for >$X/month.

tara: good call. we already have finance tags but need a billing owner signoff. i'll ping finance and cc cost-ops.

alex: handoff doc items (final checklist) I'll own:
- [ ] project created with billing and tags
- [ ] IAM roles provisioned + infra service principal with key in KMS
- [ ] terraform vpc apply + smoke test passed
- [ ] GPU quota approved by provider
- [ ] one gpu node spun, validated, and added to K8s cluster
- [ ] peering to logging/metrics project + sink verified
- [ ] runbook push to ops playbooks repo

ira: small networking gotcha: provider's managed DNS forbids CNAMEs at apex for internal delegation. if we need internal delegation use subdomain `internal.redwood.ap` and add resolver rules. call this out.

alex: noted. also will enable flow logs and export to BigQuery/ELK with 30d retention by default. ops can increase retention per cost center.

sanjay: once quota is in flight, I'll start prep for the node image bake (driver + cuda + NCCL + our tooling). target image name: redwood-gpu-ubuntu-24-ml-2026-03. Putting bake into the CI pipeline.

tara: tagging and ownership: set `oncall: infra` and `owner-email: infra@redwood.com` on the project and VPC. that helps auto-routing for alerts.

alex: final ask: can someone volunteer to review the terraform PR and the runbook before I handoff to ops on Friday? need review by Thursday EOD.

ira: I can review the network and security parts.

sanjay: I'll review compute and quota sections.

tara: I'll do billing and tagging.

alex: awesome — thank you team. I'll push the draft runbook to git and post link here when ready. expect another status update after provider quota response. :thumbsup:
